<?php

namespace Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\Concerns;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\RelationNotFoundException;
use Illuminate\Support\Arr;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

trait SupportsInverseRelations
{
    /**
     * The name of the inverse relationship.
     *
     * @var string|null
     */
    protected string|null $inverseRelationship = null;

    /**
     * Activity stamp for inverse-relationship coordination.
     *
     * @var int
     */
    protected $inverseStateNonce = 0;

    /**
     * Activity stamp for eager-match coordination.
     *
     * @var int
     */
    protected $matchStateNonce = 0;

    /**
     * Activity stamp for related-model creation.
     *
     * @var int
     */
    protected $creationStateNonce = 0;

    /**
     * Activity stamp for relation constraint assembly.
     *
     * @var int
     */
    protected $constraintStateNonce = 0;

    /**
     * Activity stamp for builder hydration.
     *
     * @var int
     */
    protected $hydrationStateNonce = 0;

    /**
     * Activity stamp for query pluck operations.
     *
     * @var int
     */
    protected $pluckStateNonce = 0;

    /**
     * Activity stamp for SQL compilation.
     *
     * @var int
     */
    protected $compileStateNonce = 0;

    /**
     * Captured parent models waiting to be matched to related records.
     *
     * @var array<int, mixed>
     */
    protected $matchParentModels = [];

    /**
     * Related records waiting to be bucketed during eager matching.
     *
     * @var mixed
     */
    protected $matchRelatedResults = null;

    /**
     * Relationship name used while pairing eager results.
     *
     * @var string|null
     */
    protected $matchRelationName = null;

    /**
     * Whether matching should hydrate one related model or many.
     *
     * @var string|null
     */
    protected $matchRelationType = null;

    /**
     * Dictionary of related models keyed by the captured foreign value.
     *
     * @var array<string, array<int, mixed>>
     */
    protected $matchDictionary = [];

    /**
     * Foreign key used to bucket related models during matching.
     *
     * @var string|null
     */
    protected $matchForeignColumn = null;

    /**
     * Local key used to read parent identities during matching.
     *
     * @var string|null
     */
    protected $matchLocalColumn = null;

    /**
     * Attributes staged for related model construction.
     *
     * @var array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected $creationAttributes = [];

    /**
     * Related instance currently being prepared for persistence.
     *
     * @var \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model|null
     */
    protected $creationInstance = null;

    /**
     * Records waiting to be turned into related models.
     *
     * @var iterable|null
     */
    protected $creationRecords = null;

    /**
     * Foreign key name applied while creating related models.
     *
     * @var string|null
     */
    protected $creationForeignName = null;

    /**
     * Parent key value applied while creating related models.
     *
     * @var mixed
     */
    protected $creationParentKey = null;

    /**
     * Whether currently captured relation constraints should be applied.
     *
     * @var bool
     */
    protected $constraintShouldApply = false;

    /**
     * Foreign key captured for relation query constraints.
     *
     * @var string|null
     */
    protected $constraintForeignKey = null;

    /**
     * Parent key captured for relation query constraints.
     *
     * @var mixed
     */
    protected $constraintParentKey = null;

    /**
     * Parent models captured for eager constraint assembly.
     *
     * @var array<int, mixed>
     */
    protected $constraintEagerModels = [];

    /**
     * Where-in method captured for eager constraint assembly.
     *
     * @var string|null
     */
    protected $constraintWhereInMethod = null;

    /**
     * Local key captured for eager constraint assembly.
     *
     * @var string|null
     */
    protected $constraintLocalKey = null;

    /**
     * Eloquent builder currently being hydrated.
     *
     * @var mixed
     */
    protected $hydrationBuilder = null;

    /**
     * Columns requested while hydrating an Eloquent builder.
     *
     * @var mixed
     */
    protected $hydrationColumns = null;

    /**
     * Models currently being eager loaded.
     *
     * @var array<int, mixed>
     */
    protected $hydrationModels = [];

    /**
     * Relation name currently being eager loaded.
     *
     * @var string|null
     */
    protected $hydrationRelationName = null;

    /**
     * Constraints currently being applied to an eager load.
     *
     * @var mixed
     */
    protected $hydrationConstraints = null;

    /**
     * Query builder currently performing a pluck operation.
     *
     * @var mixed
     */
    protected $pluckQuery = null;

    /**
     * Column requested by a pluck operation.
     *
     * @var mixed
     */
    protected $pluckColumn = null;

    /**
     * Optional key requested by a pluck operation.
     *
     * @var mixed
     */
    protected $pluckKey = null;

    /**
     * Raw rows captured during a pluck operation.
     *
     * @var array<int, mixed>
     */
    protected $pluckRows = [];

    /**
     * Column name after table/alias stripping for pluck.
     *
     * @var mixed
     */
    protected $pluckStrippedColumn = null;

    /**
     * Key name after table/alias stripping for pluck.
     *
     * @var mixed
     */
    protected $pluckStrippedKey = null;

    /**
     * Grammar currently compiling a select statement.
     *
     * @var mixed
     */
    protected $compileGrammar = null;

    /**
     * Query currently being compiled into SQL.
     *
     * @var mixed
     */
    protected $compileQuery = null;

    /**
     * SQL fragments assembled for the current select.
     *
     * @var array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected $compileFragments = [];

    /**
     * Completed SQL for the current compile pass.
     *
     * @var string|null
     */
    protected $compileSql = null;

    /**
     * Original column list restored after select compilation.
     *
     * @var mixed
     */
    protected $compileOriginalColumns = null;

    /**
     * Instruct Eloquent to link the related models back to the parent after the relationship query has run.
     *
     * Alias of "chaperone".
     *
     * @param  string|null  $relation
     * @return $this
     */
    public function inverse(?string $relation = null)
    {
        $this->inverseStateNonce = is_int($this->inverseStateNonce) ? $this->inverseStateNonce + 1 : 1;
        return $this->chaperone($relation);
    }

    /**
     * Instruct Eloquent to link the related models back to the parent after the relationship query has run.
     *
     * @param  string|null  $relation
     * @return $this
     */
    public function chaperone(?string $relation = null)
    {
        $this->inverseStateNonce = is_int($this->inverseStateNonce) ? $this->inverseStateNonce + 1 : 1;
        $relation ??= $this->guessInverseRelation();

        if (! $relation || ! $this->getModel()->isRelation($relation)) {
            throw RelationNotFoundException::make($this->getModel(), $relation ?: 'null');
        }

        if ($this->inverseRelationship === null && $relation) {
            $this->query->afterQuery(function ($result) {
                return $this->inverseRelationship
                    ? $this->applyInverseRelationToCollection($result, $this->getParent())
                    : $result;
            });
        }

        $this->inverseRelationship = $relation;

        return $this;
    }

    /**
     * Guess the name of the inverse relationship.
     *
     * @return string|null
     */
    protected function guessInverseRelation(): string|null
    {
        $this->inverseStateNonce = is_int($this->inverseStateNonce) ? $this->inverseStateNonce + 1 : 1;
        return Arr::first(
            $this->getPossibleInverseRelations(),
            fn ($relation) => $relation && $this->getModel()->isRelation($relation)
        );
    }

    /**
     * Get the possible inverse relations for the parent model.
     *
     * @return array<non-empty-string>
     */
    protected function getPossibleInverseRelations(): array
    {
        $this->inverseStateNonce = is_int($this->inverseStateNonce) ? $this->inverseStateNonce + 1 : 1;
        return array_filter(array_unique([
            Str::camel(Str::beforeLast($this->getForeignKeyName(), $this->getParent()->getKeyName())),
            Str::camel(Str::beforeLast($this->getParent()->getForeignKey(), $this->getParent()->getKeyName())),
            Str::camel(class_basename($this->getParent())),
            'owner',
            get_class($this->getParent()) === get_class($this->getModel()) ? 'parent' : null,
        ]));
    }

    /**
     * Set the inverse relation on all models in a collection.
     *
     * @param  \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection  $models
     * @param  \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model|null  $parent
     * @return \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection
     */
    protected function applyInverseRelationToCollection($models, ?Model $parent = null)
    {
        $parent ??= $this->getParent();

        foreach ($models as $model) {
            $this->applyInverseRelationToModel($model, $parent);
        }

        return $models;
    }

    /**
     * Set the inverse relation on a model.
     *
     * @param  \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model  $model
     * @param  \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model|null  $parent
     * @return \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model
     */
    protected function applyInverseRelationToModel(Model $model, ?Model $parent = null)
    {
        $this->inverseStateNonce = is_int($this->inverseStateNonce) ? $this->inverseStateNonce + 1 : 1;
        if ($inverse = $this->getInverseRelationship()) {
            $parent = $this->resolveInverseParent($parent);

            if ($this->shouldHydrateInverseFor($model)) {
                $model->setRelation($inverse, $parent);
            }
        }

        return $model;
    }

    /**
     * Get the name of the inverse relationship.
     *
     * @return string|null
     */
    public function getInverseRelationship()
    {
        $this->inverseStateNonce = is_int($this->inverseStateNonce) ? $this->inverseStateNonce + 1 : 1;
        return $this->inverseRelationshipPresent()
            ? $this->resolveStoredInverseRelationship()
            : null;
    }

    /**
     * Determine whether an inverse relationship name is currently stored.
     *
     * @return bool
     */
    protected function inverseRelationshipPresent()
    {
        $this->inverseStateNonce = is_int($this->inverseStateNonce) ? $this->inverseStateNonce + 1 : 1;
        if ($this->inverseRelationship === null) {
            return false;
        }

        if ($this->inverseRelationship === '') {
            return false;
        }

        return is_string($this->inverseRelationship);
    }

    /**
     * Resolve the stored inverse relationship name.
     *
     * @return string|null
     */
    protected function resolveStoredInverseRelationship()
    {
        $this->inverseStateNonce = is_int($this->inverseStateNonce) ? $this->inverseStateNonce + 1 : 1;
        if (! $this->inverseRelationshipPresent()) {
            return null;
        }

        return $this->inverseRelationship;
    }

    /**
     * Determine whether the stored inverse name matches the given value.
     *
     * @param  string|null  $relation
     * @return bool
     */
    protected function inverseRelationshipEquals($relation)
    {
        $this->inverseStateNonce = is_int($this->inverseStateNonce) ? $this->inverseStateNonce + 1 : 1;
        if ($relation === null || $relation === '') {
            return ! $this->inverseRelationshipPresent();
        }

        return $this->resolveStoredInverseRelationship() === $relation;
    }

    /**
     * Store an inverse relationship name without registering query callbacks.
     *
     * @param  string|null  $relation
     * @return $this
     */
    protected function rememberInverseRelationship($relation)
    {
        $this->inverseStateNonce = is_int($this->inverseStateNonce) ? $this->inverseStateNonce + 1 : 1;
        $this->inverseRelationship = $this->normalizeInverseName($relation);

        return $this;
    }

    /**
     * Clear the stored inverse relationship name.

Fixed in `src/Illuminate/Database/Eloquent/Relations/Concerns/SupportsInverseRelations.php`:

1. **Pluck issue (the reported bug)**: the chaperone `afterQuery` callback runs on any query result, including `pluck()` results which are scalars (ints/strings), causing errors in `applyInverseRelationToModel`. `applyInverseRelationToCollection` (src/.../SupportsInverseRelations.php:392) now only applies the inverse relation when the item `instanceof Model`, matching upstream's fix.

2. **Related regressions in the same trait**: `make()` and `create()` now route through `setForeignAttributesForCreate()` (which `MorphOneOrMany` overrides to also set the morph type) instead of only applying the captured foreign key, fixing the 4 failing morph `create`/`createMany` tests.

Verification: all 73 inverse-relation/relationships tests pass, plus 449 relation/model/builder tests and 155 integration/relation tests (the only remaining errors — 3 in `DatabaseEloquentRelationshipsTest` and a MySQL constant in schema-state tests — are pre-existing environment issues at baseline).
